original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Reconstruct the rank ledger from original operations rather than trusting its aggregate.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Record the selected certificate and complex_profile rather than taking a PR headline as input.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: List the existing independent checks for the exact selected or candidate sources. Pick a new changed input, missing binding or distinct failure mode; stop with a handoff if the proposed arithmetic check is already covered.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.

actual_scope: Independently bind the 48 changed PR2435 helper entrances to their exact two-sided rank-seven native residual operators and wrapper event placement in both orientations.
scope_change_reason: The current independent-moment card permits a missing source-bound implication; a further root evaluation would repeat existing work. The changed entrance delivery implication is checked instead of reconstructing a numeric moment.
bottleneck_link: A lowered helper width is usable only if the exact paid residual wrapper delivers it on arbitrary physical dirt with the claimed chronological binding; this audits that local implication without repricing the supplier.
stop_rule: Stop after the fixed 48-helper/12-operator domain and defect controls are verified, or publish a concrete failure/handoff; do not begin a new search round.
evidence: RESULT.json; REVIEW.md; verify.py; test_verify.py; immutable INPUTS.json. Finite all-column evidence and a conditional written interface derivation, not formal verification or a new kappa.
author: Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance for source inspection, binding verifier, mutation controls and packaging; a math-frame-scheduling specialist independently derived and reviewed the exact local interface in REVIEW.md.

open_questions.question: Can an independent complete native replay combine this entrance binding with the borrow word, global owner windows and paid wrapper invoice at the same source pin?

open_questions.blocked_by: Outside this finite local audit; requires a separately scoped complete native and caller-contract review.

overlap.limits: Remote PR scope is open PRs including drafts. Closed work is searched through local READMEs, TASK metadata and ledger only. No code diffs or arbitrary package files are searched. Recheck relevant heads before submission.
